name: AMD xGMI (Socket/Inter-Chip Global Memory Interconnect)
bandwidth_basis: NULL - deliberately. xGMI is AMD's die-to-die / package-to-package interconnect, and no primary AMD page retrieved as of the access date states an xGMI link rate or generation. AMD's published die-to-die figures are expressed under the Infinity Fabric name (see amd-infinity-fabric-link), and those already carry a direction ambiguity I could not resolve. Recording a separate xGMI number here would either duplicate that figure under a second name or invent one; this record is the honest gap instead.
notes: OPEN ITEM, deliberately left as nulls. xGMI is the interconnect family name AMD uses for die-to-die links inside a multi-die accelerator package (visible in the Instinct MI200-class parts referenced as 'amd-xgmi' by the accelerator records), while the package-to-package links that wire multiple OAM modules into one platform are published as Infinity Fabric. The practical consequence of leaving this null: for any current AMD accelerator, use amd-infinity-fabric-link for the scale-up fabric figure and pcie-gen5 for the host attach. To resolve: find an AMD architecture whitepaper or product brief that states an xGMI rate with an explicit direction convention, then fill version, bandwidth_gbps, bandwidth_basis, topology and scale_up / scale_out. This record also unblocks the accelerator records that reference 'amd-xgmi'.
